example.title: Fish market and restaurant on pilings at the harbour mouth

brief: A single-storey fish market and restaurant standing on timber pilings at the harbour edge: board-and-batten walls painted grey-green, a low hipped roof of pale green metal, a wraparound deck with a timber rail over the water, a rip-rap causeway and parking behind. One photo (with kayakers and sea otters). Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

names.name: Otter Point Fish Market
